task.title: Add another person
task.shortdesc: Add a person to a tree that already has someone in it.

context.p: The first person comes with a new tree. After that, you add people with . This page adds Charlotte Brontë. The sample tree already has her, so follow the steps in a tree of your own, such as the practice tree from the Quick Start.

stepresult.p: A sheet named opens. It starts with things you can add to the person you are looking at.

step.cmd: Scroll the sheet to the part named .

info.p: The sheet scrolls on its own. Turn the mouse wheel with the pointer on it.
The button stays grey until you choose a form.

stepresult.p: A form for a new person opens. Its trail ends with .

step.cmd: Type the names and choose the sex.

info.p: Only is needed. Type Charlotte there, Brontë in , and choose Female in .

step.cmd: Add the dates and places you know.

info.p: For , type 21 in , choose April in and type 1816 in . A line under the date starts Reads as and shows how the app understood it. says more.
For , type Thornton, near Bradford, Yorkshire. Places you typed before are offered under the box. says more.

step.cmd: Scroll to the foot of the form and choose .

stepresult.p: The new person is in your tree.

result.p: To check, choose , then . The new person has a card with the name and the years of life.

postreq.p: There is a shorter way to the same form. On , choose , then choose .
The sheet ends with a button that starts and has a count in brackets. It shows the other forms, such as the census forms from 1871 to 1921. Choose to hide them again.
